scope.question: Can the second quantized-write pass of encoder norm-pack be fused into current implicit INT8 conv without excessive duplicate normalization work?

decision.reason: The conv consumes each interior padded activation for up to 27 local-artifact-0262 pairs; each output-channel tile reloads and would recompute the activation quantizer independently. Existing high-resolution geometry averages about 25 recomputations per nonzero padded q cell, before spatial-reflect duplicates at source borders.
decision.single_high_impact_geometry: C128->128, D17, H=W256 is identifiable by aggregate grid geometry and is a useful local-artifact-0174 target, but its single N tile only avoids the extra factor for Cout>128; it still has up to 27x and average 25.019x recomputation. Aggregate profile does not identify the specific local-artifact-0239 pointer.
decision.conditional_path: Do not time the direct loader. Consider a private correctness-only probe, then a performance prototype only if its design reuses local-artifact-0245 values across horizontal taps within a CTA and has a static local-artifact-0311 plan. This requires a local-artifact-0144 redesign, not a small safe patch.

geometry_and_recomputation.BK_interpretation: BK64 partitions local-artifact-0173 K. For Cin128 each spatial tap contributes two K chunks; for Cin256 it contributes four. A given channel lane belongs to one chunk for a given consumer, so BK loop count is not an extra multiplier beyond the 27 local-artifact-0314 uses. The duplicated loads arise from 3x3x3 overlap and repeated pid_n activation loads.
